extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: vintage pickup truck (1940s style), approx. 5.4 x 2.0 x 2.0 m (L x W x H), wheel diameter 0.80 m
extras.notes: front faces -Y; 4 wheels are separate objects with origin on the hub (rotate around local X to roll); tailgate (vintage-truck_tailgate) has its origin on the bottom hinge, rotate around local X to open; hollow cab with split windshield, bench seat and steering wheel; separate rounded fenders, running boards, wooden bed floor; no brand, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
